# Material Plus

> A React component library implementing Material Design 3 — the components other Material libraries do not ship, and wider versions of the ones they do. Built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS v4, themed with CSS custom properties so it can coexist with an existing Material setup. ESM only, types included.

- Install with `npm install material-plus-ui`. ESM only, TypeScript declarations included.
- Peer dependencies: `@base-ui/react` 1, and `react` with `react-dom` 18 or 19. `lucide-react` ships inside the package.
- Setup is one stylesheet import — `material-plus-ui/styles.css`, or `material-plus-ui/tailwind.css` in a project already running Tailwind CSS v4 — and there is no provider to wrap the tree in.
- Every component is a named export from the package root and carries an `MP` prefix: `import { MPTextField } from 'material-plus-ui'`.
- Theming is plain CSS custom properties. `--mp-source-color` derives every colour role; `data-mp-scheme` selects light or dark and `data-mp-shape` moves the corner scale.
- Each component page below carries that component's full props table, so it is the page to read before writing a prop name.

## Components: Display

- [MPAvatar](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/avatar): A picture of a person or a thing, at a known size, that is never an empty box. If the picture is missing or slow, the initials stand in; if there are no…
- [MPBadge](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/badge): A small mark in the corner of something else: unread mail on an inbox icon, a status dot on an avatar, a count on a tab. With no children it lays out inline…
- [MPBlockquote](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/blockquote): Somebody else's words, set apart from your own. There is no state and no keyboard contract here — what there is, is markup that is easy to get wrong, and…
- [MPBreadcrumb](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/breadcrumb): The trail of pages above the one being read. The last step is where the reader already is, so it is not a link at all — and a trail seven levels deep folds its…
- [MPChatBubble](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/chat-bubble): One message in a conversation: the bubble, and everything a thread hangs around it — an avatar, a sender, a time, a delivery mark, a picture, an unfurled link.
- [MPChip](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/chip): A compact token: a tag, a filter, a status, an entity plucked out of a list. It can be pressed, it can be selected, and it can carry its own delete affordance…
- [MPDivider](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/divider): A rule between two things. With no children it is a real role="separator" and nothing else; with children the line breaks around the label.
- [MPHighlight](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/highlight): Marks the words a reader is looking for, inside text they were already reading. The component is the search, not just the styling: query is whatever a search…
- [MPIcon](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/icon): A wrapper that gives an icon glyph a size and a colour. Material Plus draws no icons of its own, so the glyph comes from whichever set you chose — lucide-react…
- [MPList](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/list): A stack of rows. The list is a sheet and the rows are what is on it — which is why size and color are set once, on the stack, and why a row that navigates is a…
- [MPPagination](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/pagination): A row of pages, one of which is the one being read. Material has no pagination component, so what is Material here is everything around the decision: pills at…
- [MPPill](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/pill): A floating lozenge holding a small amount of live information — a call in progress, an upload that is still going, a recording, a train two minutes away.
- [MPShortcut](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/shortcut): A keyboard key, or a combination of them. Two things make it more than a styled &lt;kbd&gt; , and both are about the label rather than the box around it.
- [MPSpoiler](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/spoiler): Content that is covered until somebody asks for it. A plot twist, a salary range, a photograph with a warning on it — visible as a shape, unreadable by…
- [MPTable](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/table): A grid of data, described by its columns rather than written out row by row. The header and the cells cannot drift apart, because there is only one place that…
- [MPTextLink](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/text-link): A link, in a sentence or on its own. Everything about it is deliberately smaller than a button — no surface, no height of its own, no colour unless asked. What…
- [MPTimeline](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/timeline): A sequence of steps, in the order they happen in. One prop says how far reality has got, and every bullet, line and heading follows from it.
- [MPTypography](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/display/typography): Text at one of Material's type roles. The type scale is the one thing in a design system everything else is measured against — this is that ladder on its own,…

- [MPRadioGroup](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/inputs/radio-group): A set of options where exactly one is chosen. Material's 20dp ring with a 10dp fill inside it, and — the part that matters — one tab stop for the whole set,…

- [MPSlider](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/inputs/slider): A value chosen along a range. The active part of the track is the accent family and the rest is surface-container-highest, which is Material's own pairing and…

## Components: Layout

- [MPAccordion](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/accordion): A stack of sections, one of which is open. Opening the next closes the last, which is the whole reason it is not simply a stack of collapsibles.
- [MPAspectRatio](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/aspect-ratio): A box that keeps a proportion whatever width it is given. It draws nothing — what it does is reserve the space, so a card whose image arrives late does not…
- [MPBottomNavigation](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/bottom-navigation): A row of destinations held against the bottom edge of the window. Material calls this the navigation bar , and what is drawn is the specification's: an 80dp…
- [MPBox](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/box): A sheet with content on it. The plainest surface in the library: it groups things, and that is all it does.
- [MPCard](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/card): An MPBox with the parts a card is made of laid out on it: a picture, a heading, a subheading, a body and a footer. MD3's own card anatomy, in slots.
- [MPCarousel](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/carousel): A strip of slides, one of which is in view. Built on the browser's own scrolling with CSS snap points, so swiping, trackpad dragging and the arrow keys all…
- [MPCollapsible](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/collapsible): One section that folds, standing on its own. A "Show more" on a form, an optional block of settings, the detail under a row — with the panel's height animated…
- [MPContainer](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/container): The page margin, and optionally a measure. Material holds content off the edge of the window by 16dp in a compact window and 24dp from medium up — this is that…
- [MPDrawer](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/drawer): A panel attached to one edge of the window. Two things in one component, because they are the same panel: the drawer you open, and the drawer that is simply…
- [MPGrid](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/grid): Material's layout grid: a row divided into columns, and items that take some of them. The column count changes with the window size class the specification…
- [MPPanes](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/panes): A set of panes with draggable handles between them. The split is described in fractions, so it survives the window being resized without a single line of…
- [MPTabs](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/layout/tabs): One set of panels, one of which is shown. Material's two kinds of tab are here as variant — primary for the top level of a screen and secondary for a division…

## Components: Motion

- [MPAnimateAppear](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-appear): A list of things settling into place one after another. The effect belongs to the set rather than to any one item, which is what walks a reader's eye down it…
- [MPAnimateBlink](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-blink): Content pulsing between full opacity and a floor. A recording light, a live badge, a count that has just changed — and the one effect here that should be…
- [MPAnimateFade](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-fade): Content arriving or leaving on opacity alone. Nothing moves, so nothing reflows and no text is resampled — the one entrance that is safe on a block of prose at…
- [MPAnimateGrow](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-grow): Content unfolding from a point. A panel out of a toolbar, a card out of the row it sits in, a sheet out of the button that summoned it.
- [MPAnimateHeadline](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-headline): One line replacing the one above it, on a timer. A set of phrases where any one of them would have done — three ways of saying what a product is, a rotating…
- [MPAnimateLighting](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-lighting): A light travelling around the outside of something. The way to say "this one, now" without moving anything — the row that is processing, the field being…
- [MPAnimateMarquee](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-marquee): Content scrolling steadily past, forever. Two copies laid end to end, moving at the pace of a reader rather than at whatever pace fits the box.
- [MPAnimateRotate](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-rotate): Content turning about a point. Two angles rather than one, which is what lets one component be both a swing into place and a spin that never lands.
- [MPAnimateSlide](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-slide): Content travelling in from one edge. The element moves, the layout does not — nothing on the page reflows while it runs.
- [MPAnimateTyping](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-typing): Text appearing one character at a time. The whole string is in the document from the first frame, so nothing reflows and nobody is kept waiting on the…
- [MPAnimateZoom](https://material-plus.cdget.com/components/motion/animate-zoom): Content arriving from the middle of where it will end up. The effect for the one thing on a screen that is meant to interrupt — a confirmation, a result, a…
